Name: Bee Cursor
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/WhDHkoZ.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]Ever wanted your stardew pointer to be a chunky bee? Then this mod is for you! 
This mod simply changes your cursor into a nice lit bee theme, made by yours truly.

This mod works with any other mods, including most interfaces!
that is as long as the interface [i]custom cursor option is turned off[/i], as they edit the same sprites I do.

alright that's it~ ty[/center]
